pattern: A fieldset of native form controls (select, number inputs, radio groups, toggle buttons) with a legend, a live summary, and a list of next occurrences.

aria.value: Help text, error message, and the summary
Full weekday name (the visible text is the narrow name)
"Day of month", "Week of the month", "Weekday", "Month", "Number of occurrences"

keyboard.action: Moves through the frequency select, interval, weekday toggles, radios, inline selects, the end date, and the count.
Native radio selection (the inline controls follow).

focus: Every control is native and in document order; hidden rows (for other frequencies) are not focusable. Rebuilding options keeps the selected values.
notes: The summary is a polite live region, so each change is read as a sentence ("Every 2 weeks on Monday and Wednesday").
Radio groups are grouped by name but have no form owner, so only the hidden input is submitted.
knownCaveats: Screen-reader behavior has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
